name: Event Subscriber Example Plugin
author: Anthony Rubick
description: An example plugin for event subscriptions, will display all events in the UI

subscriptions_events.accessRuleCreated: This event is triggered when a new access ruleset is created
subscriptions_events.blacklistToggled: This event is triggered when the blacklist is toggled for an access rule
subscriptions_events.blacklistedIpBlocked: This event is triggered when a blacklisted IP is blocked
subscriptions_events.customEvent: This event is a custom event that can be emitted by any plugin, we subscribe to it to demonstrate a "monitor" plugin that can see all custom events emitted by other plugins
